section_summary.extract_value: This convergent validity section reports that BAS-2 total scores correlate positively with self-esteem and life satisfaction. Body appreciation is described as negatively associated with BMI among women and positively associated among men; additionally, a curvilinear relationship in men prompted examination of BMI squared, with BMI2 correlating r = .12 (p = .006) with body appreciation in men. There was also a positive significant correlation between body appreciation and age in men but not women.
